paragraph: Overwhelmed building call rotas? A generator gives you a draft to repair. Scheduling Wizard gives you the finished call schedule.

cta.title: Get Your On Call Schedule Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: A generator is software that produces a draft call schedule from rules you configure. This is not that. The draft is the easy half; what follows is checking it against your requirements, fixing what does not hold and absorbing the knock-on effects of each fix. We do that part, which is why what comes back is a finished schedule rather than a starting point.
faq.question: What is an on call schedule generator, and is that what this is?

faq.answer: ACGME duty hour rules are applied as the schedule is built, not checked manually after the fact. Our team applies the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest requirements, and the 24-hour cap for continuous duty, along with subspecialty-specific rules built into the system. This means the rules are applied while the schedule is built, not discovered during an audit.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME compliance in call schedules?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard distributes call, weekends, and holidays equitably across all residents in a program. Our team balances total call burden simultaneously across the schedule, taking into account each resident's individual rules and preferences so that no resident is disproportionately burdened compared to their peers.
faq.question: How is on-call burden distributed fairly across residents?

faq.answer: Most scheduling tools are self-service platforms that require chief residents to learn and operate the software themselves. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service, programs submit their rules and receive finished schedules, built to your rules, back as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, with no software to install or learn. Our schedulers handle the complexity. Programs can still upload the finished schedules to your existing platform for day-to-day viewing.
faq.question: What makes Scheduling Wizard different from self-service scheduling software?

faq.answer: Yes. Scheduling Wizard handles mid-year revisions including sick leave, parental leave, coverage changes, and new rules. Affected portions of the on-call schedule are rebuilt without disrupting the rest of the schedule, so programs do not need to manually reshuffle assignments every time something changes.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard handle mid-year changes to the on call schedule?

faq.answer: When chiefs change annually, scheduling knowledge typically disappears with them. With Scheduling Wizard, your program's rules and requests are written down and kept year over year. Incoming chief residents inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule instead of rebuilding everything from scratch each year.
faq.question: How does institutional knowledge persist when chief residents rotate annually?
